headline: RBI Issues Updated Foreign Exchange Rules for Goods and Services Trade
summary: The Reserve Bank of India published second amendment regulations under the Foreign Exchange Management Act for export and import of goods and services. The principle-based rules aim to simplify trade compliance for businesses.
why: The Reserve Bank of India regulates cross-border financial transactions and foreign exchange flows, setting operational parameters for Indian exporters and importers.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: The Reserve Bank of India amended trade foreign exchange regulations to improve ease of doing business.
